✦ AI Agent Zručnosti

Zručnosti & Schopnosti

Full-stack AI inžinierstvo — od orchestrácie LLM a slučiek Hermes Agenta po cloudovú infraštruktúru, regulačné povedomie a hardvérové inžinierstvo.

Hermes Agent & Multi-Agentové systémy

  • Hermes Agent: Autonómne exekučné slučky & reflexia na 24/7 Hetzner VPS
  • MCP Architektúra: Vlastné Model Context Protocol nástroje a integračné API
  • OpenRouter Multi-LLM: Dynamické smerovanie modelov (DeepSeek, Claude 3.5 & GPT-4o)
  • Obsidian Memory Layer: Obojsmerný markdown vault ako perzistentná pamäť agentov
  • C2 Rozhrania: Interaktívne riadenie a kontrola cez Telegram & WhatsApp botov

Softvér, Vysokovýkonný Web & Cloud

  • Python 3 Ekosystém: FastAPI, Asyncio, Playwright, automatizácia toolchainov
  • Zero-Build Web: 100% Čistý HTML5/CSS3/JS, PageSpeed 100 a 0ms TBT bez frameworkového balastu
  • GEO & Agentic Browsing: Štandard llmstxt.org v2, optimalizácia pre Perplexity a LLM crawlery
  • Linux VPS Administrácia: Ubuntu Server na Hetzner Cloud (DE/FI), Caddy reverzný proxy & SSL
  • Produkčné Operácie: 19+ 24/7 cron orchestrácií, SQLite perzistencia & monitoring

Regulačné Povedomie (EU AI Act, GDPR, NIS2)

  • EU AI Act: Klasifikácia rizík, správa GPAI modelov a technická dokumentácia
  • GDPR & Ochrana súkromia: Súlad trénovacích dát, garancie proti profilovaniu
  • NIS2 & DORA: Kybernetická odolnosť dodávateľského reťazca & fintech pripravenosť
  • EU Data Act: Zdieľanie dát, interoperabilita cloudov a dátová suverenita EÚ
  • DSM Autorské právo: Výnimky pre Text & Data Mining (TDM) pri trénovaní AI modelov

Taktické UAV Systémy & Edge Robotika

  • Hardvérová Stavba: Ručne spájkovaný 1500g 8-palcový karbónový quad z komponentov
  • Letový Softvér: Duálne ladenie dynamiky Betaflight & misie waypointov v ArduPilot Copter
  • Edge Vision AI: Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB) + Camera 3 pre palubnú detekciu objektov
  • Avionika & Telemetria: Skystars H7 Dual Gyro FC, AM60 60A ESC, RadioMaster ELRS, GNSS
  • Certifikácie: Licencovaný pilot dronov EASA A1/A3, poistenie Coverdrone 2,6 mil. €
✦ FAQ & Knowledge Base

Frequently Asked Questions

Structured answers regarding AI agent architectures, legal compliance, hardware builds, and collaborations.

Who is Marian Stancik?
+
Marian Stancik is an AI Agent Developer. He builds autonomous systems on Hermes Agent (by Nous Research), MCP, and 24/7 production infrastructure. His regulatory awareness helps him build compliance-ready systems.
What is Hermes Agent and how does Marian use it?
+
Hermes Agent is an autonomous agent framework. Marian deploys Hermes Agent on a dedicated European Hetzner Cloud VPS running 24/7 background cron loops, interfacing via custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, with dynamic model routing through OpenRouter API, persistent long-term memory managed in an Obsidian knowledge vault, and interactive Command & Control (C2) through Telegram and WhatsApp.
What infrastructure powers Marian's autonomous agents?
+
Autonomous agents run on a Linux Ubuntu VPS hosted in Hetzner Cloud (Nuremberg and Helsinki data centers), ensuring strict EU regulatory alignment and data sovereignty. The stack consists of Python 3, FastAPI, Caddy reverse proxy, SQLite, 19+ cron orchestrations, Obsidian Markdown second brain for memory, and zero-build Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/JS for high-performance interfaces (Lighthouse 100).
What is Marian's regulatory knowledge in AI governance and EU regulations?
+
Marian studies legal-by-design architectures covering:
  • EU AI Act: Risk classification, GPAI governance, and technical documentation.
  • GDPR: Training data privacy and automated decision safeguards.
  • NIS2 Directive & DORA: Cybersecurity resilience and financial operational readiness.
  • EU Data Act & DSM Directive: Data sovereignty and Text & Data Mining (TDM) exceptions for AI training.

⚠️ This is shared for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice.

What are the technical specs of Marian's tactical UAV build?
+
A custom-built 1500g carbon tactical quadcopter with an 8-inch GEPRC Mark4 frame, Skystars H7 Dual Gyro FC, AM60 60A ESC stack, iFlight XING2 2809 1250Kv motors, 6S 5500mAh LiPo, RadioMaster ELRS telemetry, and FlyfishRC GNSS. It runs ArduPilot Copter autopilot software with an onboard Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB) companion computer and Camera Module 3 for real-time computer vision target detection. Certified EASA A1/A3 with €2.6M Coverdrone insurance.
